episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Former President George Mullen's comfortable retirement is upended after he's asked to lead an investigation into a horrific cyberattack

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Mullen's commission investigates a hacking ring. President Mitchell weighs retaliation. A powerful figure has demands for Roger.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Mullen's initial arrests draw blowback from the public — especially TV pundit Evan Green. Alex faces pressure to investigate her father.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A shock to the financial system increases scrutiny on Mullen's commission. Valerie investigates Proteus. Roger must make a difficult choice.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A personal tragedy reopens old wounds for the Mullen family. Speaker Dreyer pushes for a change in leadership. Sheila testifies before Congress.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A new threat creates further unrest across the nation. As he narrows in on the culprit, Mullen is faced with an agonizing decision.
